claim_boundary.local_vs_formal: Local scaffold success and exact-template match remain separate from Jasper proof status.
claim_boundary.proof_vs_intent: A proven candidate is proof-checked on the correct RTL/harness but is not automatically certified as the intended repair; exact-template/local scaffold metrics remain the intent-alignment proxy for this run.
claim_boundary.best_of_k: Best-of-handoff-candidates pass@k is an upper-bound over candidates present in the sanitized handoff artifact. It is not reported as single-output repair success.
claim_boundary.vacuity: jasper_vacuity_status is null for every candidate, so not_flagged_vacuous means proven and not parsed as vacuous, not an independent explicit non-vacuity certificate.
claim_boundary.production: No production readiness or full signoff automation claim is made.
